user_saw: Historical messages with no recorded author could show the signed-in viewer’s name and avatar in chat, use the viewer’s name in reply previews, and appear under “You” in Markdown exports.
summary: The fix labels unattributed inputs “Message” in chat, reply previews, and Markdown exports and suppresses their avatars without changing stored messages.
reasoning: The grouped renderer already fell back to `userLabel ?? resolvedUserName` before the Control UI architecture refactor, and Markdown export already used “You” before the export commits in the blame candidates. The chat fallback was present at the July 1 history boundary, and the offline history lookup could not recover its introduction. The available diffs also did not establish a later change that first exposed the false attribution.
